description_en: Detaches tags from resources in Cloud Config
description_zh: 为配置审计中的资源解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun config untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ACS::Config::Rule --resource-id cr-115b626622af00600000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en:
The type of the CloudConfig resource. Valid values:

`ACS::Config::Rule`: a rule for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`: a rule for multiple accounts.

`ACS::Config::Aggregator`: an account group.

`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`: a compliance package for a single account.

`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`: a compliance package for multiple accounts
parameters.help_zh:
配置审计的资源类型。取值：
`ACS::Config::Rule`：单账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::AggregateConfigRule`：多账号下的规则。
`ACS::Config::Aggregator`：账号组。
`ACS::Config::CompliancePack`：单账号下的合规包。
`ACS::Config::AggregateCompliancePack`：多账号下的合规包
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the resources. You can specify a maximum of 50 resource IDs.

You can detach tags from up to 50 resources at a time
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

单次最多支持为50个资源解绑标签
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The tag keys of the tags to detach
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resources. Valid values:

true: Detach all tags from the resources.

false (default): Detach the specified tags
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。取值：

true：解绑资源上全部的标签。

false（默认值）：解绑资源上指定的标签
parameters.name: all
